cast.say: Has anyone seen a small sock?
We are in the middle of a war!

panels.caption: The longest peace in fort history.

cast.say: Time for the annual militia review.
This year: three goblins, one troll.
Just a quick drink at the river.
Bomrek, it is the middle of the night.
Engrave me a slab and I'll go.
Close enough to haunt you forever.
We built you a coffin, Bomrek!
I can't rest either. Pour it.
I've been number one for a decade.
No leather. Only ethically sourced feelings.
There is no sand. I will go insane.
A fey mood! I need almost nothing!
A gem, a bar, a log, and silence.

panels.caption: It is a different stone. He knows.

cast.say: Gerald wasn't unused. He had me.

panels.caption: Gerald now lives in the well.

cast.say: We built a minecart! No more hauling!
Who hauls the stone TO the minecart?
He's going to outlive the mountain.
I don't run. I don't do anything.
Party at my lair! Everyone come!
I brought you a shiny gem!
I'm a dwarf. A very tall one.
It says it is made of fire.
Got a sock instead. Still counts.
All the vermin you can eat.
My inside man fell asleep inside.
Fine. Cut it. I'll come back.

gags.caption: The carp have started a lifeguard program. Enrollment is mandatory.
"This bowl? From a tree that died of natural sadness."
Urist calls the magma channel a 'hot tub.' The coroner calls it 'Tuesday.'
He has been searching for the left sock since the second siege.
The census counts {cats} cats. The cats' census counts one dwarf, barely.
Today's forecast: scattered mugs, with a chance of flying tables.
"The little suns mean it's better than you."
Plump helmets: breakfast, lunch, dinner, and, since the flood, roommate.
"It's just the sky, Urist." "That's what it wants you to think."
The cook insists the miasma is 'part of the ambience.'
"Strike the earth!" The earth has filed a formal complaint.
Aquifer breached. The basement is a lake. The lake has tenants.
Day 12 of 'we'll just keep one kitten.'
The necromancer's tower: lovely views, terrible neighbors, worse neighbors after.
The new bookkeeper never sleeps, never eats, and the records are spotless. Odd.
"I wish for a bucket."
Dwarven syrup: for the dwarf who finds wine a bit too watery.
Minecart safety rule one: there are no minecart safety rules.
The hospital's only treatment: a bed, a splint, and a strongly worded note.
The bard knows one song. It's about a carp. It is forty minutes long.
The library has three books, all titled 'On Rocks.' Volume 2 is a rock.
New migrants: no skills, fourteen opinions about the beds.
The overseer sees all. Mostly it sees the cats.
"We have {drinks} drinks inside. Take your time out there."
Urist swears he's just 'not a morning person.' The full moon disagrees.
Technically, the cave-in was the fastest mining we've ever done.
Danger room graduates: three. Danger room survivors: also three. Mostly.
Today's mandate: no more things I don't like. Tomorrow's: no more things.
We offered stone crafts. They offered our stone crafts back, at a markup.
Meeting hall attendance is at a record high. No one knows what the meeting is.
Coffins, two for one. Unrelated: the forgotten beast woke up.
Weather: {weather}. Dwarves: indoors. Elves: outside, hugging it.
{pop} dwarves. One well. Infinite opinions about the bucket.
Year {year} in review: like last year, but with more {stone}.
Babies may be carried into battle but must be returned washed.
The war dogs have adopted a goblin. He is now a very good boy.
{masterwright} made a masterwork {masterwork}. Nobody can make them stop mentioning it.
{promoted} is now {post}. First official act: a bigger chair.
Winter in {fort}: the river froze with three carp still glaring.
Wood is so scarce the carpenter now points at rocks and says 'tree.'
The farmer talks to the plump helmets. Worse, they're starting to answer.
The jeweler cut it so finely it's now mostly air. Valued at triple.
{drinks} drinks left. The dwarves have begun drafting a strongly worded song.
The elven diplomat demands we stop cutting trees. He arrived in a wooden cart.
"Technically, I'm a very short merchant."
The founding motto. The second motto, carved below, just says 'Run.'
Hauling order: booze, booze, booze, food, booze, then that one stone.
"I said I needed SILENCE, not a knock asking if I need silence."
